name: mechanism
description: What SRS does about it, mechanism by mechanism.

aiGuidance.purpose: A list where each item names one SRS mechanism (immutable ids, typed fields, typed relations, supersession, compositions, guidance) and says what it refuses or makes possible. Describe the mechanism, never a product feature or a promise. Say plainly where a rule is the repository's own governance and not a tool rule. Never an em dash.
